writeup: Woot has a factory-reconditioned Shark HX105 StainForce cordless portable spot, stain, and odor remover in Slate Blue for $59.99. The offer includes the grab-and-go caddy, stain eliminator and crevice tools, a rubber bristle strip, and a full-size 16.9 oz dual-activated solution. Woot showed 3 left with a limit of 3 per customer. We did not find an in-stock non-Amazon listing for this exact HX105. Shark's own site currently sells the related new HX101, a same-series sibling in a different color, for $129.99; that is context for the series, not a verified match of this factory-reconditioned HX105. This page was published at Rob's request.
